description: An object's name -> what the convention reads in it (convention.ObjectRole: parse, door, coupled, hasToken INTERIOR). input.name; expected: control (null, or kind, gauge, id, key, group, label, flags, offset, range, slide in the OBJ frame), pivot_degrees (null if no hinge marker), light_group, light_invert, fullbright, headlight, rgb, interior_token, door (the name read as a door leaf: control fields and pivot_degrees, or null), coupled (front, shown: COUPLED/UNCOUPLED/ALWAYS, or null).

a copy suffix after the degrees: dropped first
a coupler head with a copy suffix
a door leaf's hinge with a copy suffix
four digits are no copy suffix: WIDGET_1 is then followed by a point, no control
a copy suffix right after the number
both a lever and a gauge: the kinds are tried in order, the gauge first
a letter before GAUGE: not a gauge, but THROTTLE_1 after an underscore is a lever
HIDE on a widget: a control flag
HIDE on a window: a control flag (the model drops the object)
a rear coupler head shown while coupled
a range that runs backwards
a range with no low end: the fallback 0
a range of garbage: 0 and 1
the last range wins even when it is garbage
a slide on all three axes
two slides on one axis: the last
a slide of garbage: 0
TL on no axis is no slide
ROT with an empty token after it: 0 degrees
ROTX contains the key and _ROT: a hinge, with no ROT token for degrees
degrees in exponent form
degrees with a float suffix
degrees in hexadecimal
NaN degrees: no hinge at all
infinite degrees
minus zero degrees
twenty digits: the number held at the largest int
the largest int
one past the largest int
leading zeros: the number 7, the key as written
OFFSET with nothing after it: 0
an offset of garbage: 0
an offset in hexadecimal
an offset with a float suffix
an offset in exponent form
a colour that isn't hexadecimal: white
five hex digits are no colour
seven hex digits are no colour
a colour in small letters
two carets: two blanks
LABEL with nothing after it: no label
CG with nothing after it: its own group
two groups: the first
LCG with nothing after it: no light
a light lit while its group is off
INTERIOR alone is the token
a letter before INTERIOR: no token
FULLBRIGHT alone: lit always
a door leaf with a hinge and a slide
a door leaf of too many digits
a bell button of the example pack
a door switch of the example pack
a gauge the engine has no value for
COUPLED_<n> without an end: a gauge, no coupler head
